verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs explicitly describe first-class monorepo support: workspace protocol for cross-linked local packages, single lockfile across the workspace, filtering to run tasks on touched projects, and catalogs for shared dependency versions to avoid drift. Community evidence corroborates this in practice, with users praising pnpm's built-in monorepo support after migrating from Lerna/Yarn. Missing for 10: no independent large-scale case study detailing lockfile conflict resolution at scale, and some community reports note occasional symlink/dependency-linking glitches in monorepos.
